props.text: Medal & Record Policy
Annual Series
1. Purpose & Scope

This policy governs medal badges, record designations, and performance statistics displayed exclusively on Peace in Pressure (PIP) Annual Series trading cards. Peace in Pressure may release additional card series (including special editions, invitational series, or experimental formats). Such series may follow different representation rules and are not governed by this policy unless explicitly stated.
2. Governing Bodies Recognized
For the PIP Annual Series, medal and record eligibility is limited to achievements officially recognized by at least one internationally sanctioned freediving governing body:
AIDA CMAS
Peace in Pressure respects the independent rules, judging standards, and validation processes of both organizations.
3. Unified Medal Badging System
PIP utilizes a unified, federation-neutral approach that honors the achievement itself, rather than the governing body under which it was recognized.
A. World Record, Continental and National Badge (WR, CR, NR)

A Record medal badges may be displayed if a performance has been officially ratified as a Record by AIDA, CMAS, or both. Historical RecognitionUnique to the World Record tier, a WR/CR/NR badge may be displayed if the athlete officially held the Record at any point during the applicable Annual Series year, provided the record was ratified prior to the Production Cut-off Date. Legacy StatusA Record that is later surpassed or broken within the same Annual Series year does not invalidate the WR/CR/NR badge for that athlete’s card. Federation NeutralityThe WR/CR/NR badge does not specify the governing body and does not display federation branding. Future Reservation of RightsPeace in Pressure reserves the right to apply the Historical Recognition / Legacy Status logic to any records in future Annual Series editions. Any such change will be clearly disclosed at the time of release.
4. Stats & Performance Representation

Official Results: Depths, disciplines, and statistics reflect results officially recognized by AIDA or CMAS Clean Design: Federation names, logos, or parallel records are not displayed Date of Record: The “Date of Record” reflects the date the performance occurred, regardless of administrative ratification timing No Double-Counting: Identical achievements recognized by both organizations are counted once
All statistics represent a snapshot of verified achievements as of the Production Cut-off Date and are not intended to reflect real-time rankings or current personal bests.
5. Eligibility & Verification
All Annual Series medals and records must meet the following verification standards:
Official Sanctioning: Ratified by AIDA or CMAS Rule Compliance: Meets applicable judging and safety protocols Public Record: Supported by verifiable documentation
Federation details may be reviewed internally but are not displayed on the card.
6. Exclusions
The following do not qualify for unified medal or record badges in the Annual Series:

Training dives or personal bests outside official competition

Unsanctioned events

Pending, disputed, or unratified claims

Achievements recognized by organizations other than AIDA or CMAS
Such achievements may appear as non-medal highlights at PIP’s discretion and will be visually distinguished from official badges.
7. Production Cut-off & Final Authority

Data FreezeAll card data is subject to a Production Cut-off Date established for each Annual Series (e.g., December 31 at 11:59 PM local time). FinalityPeace in Pressure retains final discretion over all medal eligibility, badge usage, and stat presentation. Retroactive ChangesOnce printed, Peace in Pressure is not obligated to modify, recall, or reprint physical cards if a governing body later nullifies, alters, or reverses an achievement.
